# Iron Custom Motors

> Premium motorcycle service workshop in Cascais, Greater Lisbon (Portugal),
> run by an internationally recognized custom-motorcycle team —
> AMD World Champions, BMW Motorrad Customizing Champion 2023,
> Bonneville Salt Flats world record holder 2017 (class 350APS-VG),
> Ericeira Kustom Fest 2026 Best Paint winner and Café Racer runner-up.

Iron Custom Motors is a full-service motorcycle workshop offering scheduled
maintenance and repair, parts and consumables sourcing, performance and
touring upgrades, pre-purchase inspections for used motorcycles, and custom
bike projects. The team services modern, classic, and custom motorcycles
across all major brands (Harley-Davidson, BMW Motorrad, Ducati, Triumph,
KTM, Honda, Yamaha, Kawasaki, Suzuki, Aprilia, MV Agusta, Indian).

The workshop is in Cascais, in São Domingos de Rana — about 20 minutes from
central Lisbon. Hours: Tuesday–Saturday 10:00–18:00. Closed Sunday and
Monday. Languages spoken: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Portuguese.

- Address: R. António José da Silva 100 B, 2785-253 São Domingos de Rana, Cascais
- Phone / WhatsApp: +351 917 961 230
- Email: Ironcustom.office@gmail.com
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@IronCustomMotors
- Hourly rate: 50€/h
- Pre-purchase inspection: 150€ flat
- Diagnostics: 50–350€ depending on depth
- Scheduled service: from 150€

## Services

- [Motorcycle service & repair](https://ironcustommotors.com/motorcycle-service/): Diagnostics, scheduled maintenance, oil and filter service, brake service, suspension work, chain and sprockets, tire service, electrical diagnostics, general repair across all brands.
- [Parts & consumables](https://ironcustommotors.com/parts/): OEM, aftermarket and tuning parts. Service consumables and accessories. Sourced through major international catalogs.
- [Upgrades & tuning](https://ironcustommotors.com/upgrades-tuning/): Performance, suspension, brakes, exhaust, lighting, protection, touring and luggage upgrades selected for real-world riding.
- [Custom & special projects](https://ironcustommotors.com/custom/): Custom consultations, bespoke builds, individual engineering by the team behind world-champion motorcycles.
- [Pre-purchase inspection](https://ironcustommotors.com/pre-purchase-inspection/): Independent expert check before buying a used motorcycle in Portugal. Mechanical, electrical, frame inspection with written report and photos within 24 hours. 150€ flat regardless of brand.

## Latest news

- [Iron Custom Motors at Ericeira Kustom Fest 2026](https://ironcustommotors.com/news/ericeira-kustom-fest-2026/): First major custom competition for the Portugal-based team; Hell Boy won 1st place in Best Paint and Sturmvogel took 2nd place in Café Racer.
- [Iron Custom Motors at Lisbon Motorcycle Film Fest 2026](https://ironcustommotors.com/news/lisbon-motorcycle-film-fest-2026-beckman/): Festival participation with the championship-winning Beckman custom motorcycle.
- [Iron Custom Motors opens in Cascais](https://ironcustommotors.com/news/opens-new-workshop-in-cascais/): New motorcycle workshop in Cascais, Greater Lisbon.
